title: Serre comparison for the graded section module
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with its standard grading, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. Let $\mathcal G$ be a coherent [pqf-def-coherent] $\mathcal O_P$-module, write $\mathcal G(n)=\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal O_P(n)$ for the twists by $\mathcal O_P(n)$ of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], put $M_{\ge 0}=\bigoplus_{n\ge 0}\Gamma(P,\mathcal G(n))$ with its graded $S$-module structure, and let $\widetilde{M_{\ge 0}}$ be the associated sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. The canonical morphism $\widetilde{M_{\ge 0}}\to\mathcal G$, whose restriction on each standard open $D_+(f)$ is induced by degree-zero localization of sections, is an isomorphism.
